config.description: Validates the DevSpace boundary and cross-space ORIGINATED_FROM topology after a meta-learning promotion event.

prerequisites.description: Simulate the promotion of a Layer 4 concept from space 'source-repo' to 'mdemg-global'.

test_cases.description: A node promoted to the global space must maintain an ORIGINATED_FROM edge pointing back to its local source node.
test_cases.query: MATCH (g:MemoryNode {space_id: 'mdemg-global'})-[r:ORIGINATED_FROM]->(s:MemoryNode) RETURN count(r) AS edge_count, s.space_id AS source_space

test_cases.description: Global space nodes must be connected to the mdemg-global TapRoot, not the local space TapRoot.
